page_title: Mullvad VPN - Privacy is for the people

sources.entry: Mullvad VPN - Privacy-focused VPN service with anonymous accounts and flat-rate access. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/mullvad/mullvadvpn-app)

summary.name: Mullvad VPN
summary.one_liner: Mullvad VPN is a privacy-focused VPN service with anonymous accounts, and the page also promotes the Mullvad Browser, which is developed by the Tor Project.
use_cases: hide IP address from websites and trackers
keep ISP from seeing online activity
browse privately with a privacy-focused browser
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Mullvad VPN as a service that encrypts traffic to create a private connection, so the user's ISP cannot see their activity and others cannot use their IP address to track them. It states there is no logging and that accounts are anonymous. It lists circumvention of censorship and defence against AI-guided traffic analysis as features. It also promotes Mullvad Browser, described as open source, free of charge, and developed by the Tor Project, for use with or without the VPN. The page is largely advocacy about privacy and includes a promotional short film about mass surveillance.
notable: Mullvad Browser developed by the Tor Project, open source and free
Claims to combat AI-guided traffic analysis
caveats: VPN is a paid service at €5/month as listed on the page
The page does not name the client platforms the VPN runs on
